item.title: Large Scale Dumping/Litter/Flytip, 23rd September
item.description:
At this location, behind the stores, there is an apparent constant massive pile of material waste and flytip (mattresses, large cardboard boxes, bins etc...). I know this area isn't the Council's responsibility, but this waste is so great that it is regularly spilling out onto the pavement and causing a litter, and at times, blockage issue for pedestrians. Naturally, some folk take advantage of this and also use this area as a large litter bin during the weekends. Is there anything the Council can do here? Put up some notices about flytipping? Inform the stores along this section? This small area is really looking terrible at times.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): The Drive, Beckenham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
